verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an official nitropy CLI, described as a 'Command line tool to interact with Nitrokey devices', and a Python SDK on PyPI. None of the evidence documents reading device state such as serial number, firmware version, enabled applications or stored credentials. A generic device-interaction CLI is an adjacent building block, not documented support for programmatic state readout or fleet auditing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can read a key's state programmatically — serial, firmware version, enabled applications, stored credentials — to audit security posture across a fleet
